method: Independent read-only source and retained-evidence review. No new application execution, UI operation, test run or target execution by this reviewer.
status: Previously reported failure paths are addressed in the pinned revision; no remaining actionable defect identified in this bounded review.

fixed_findings.issue: Unbounded source-offset conversion during waveform rebuilding
fixed_findings.resolution: Waveform conversion now checks finite products, actual source bounds and Int64 representability. Loaded clips also receive shared source-interval validation before shell assignment.

fixed_findings.issue: Save As required writing the original project
fixed_findings.resolution: For a distinct destination, create a new owner-writable root, copy source children except Project.json, and save the current in-memory project only at the destination. Root/name/dirty-state commit occurs after save succeeds.

fixed_findings.issue: Failed save could be followed by unguarded New/Open/Quit
fixed_findings.resolution: New/Open and applicationShouldTerminate use the same Save/Keep Editing/Discard decision. saveProject and saveProjectAs return false on errors or cancellation.

fixed_findings.issue: Open-current-project read stale manifest before requested Save
fixed_findings.resolution: load now obtains replacement permission before reading the target project.

fixed_findings.issue: Save As could copy a directory symlink instead of its package
fixed_findings.resolution: Source root is resolved before directory enumeration/copy; target and containment checks use resolved paths.

fixed_findings.issue: Destination inherited readonly root permissions or a failed copy escaped cleanup
fixed_findings.resolution: Distinct destination root is explicitly created with mode0700; createdDestination is set immediately after successful creation, before copying children, so subsequent failure attempts removal.

control_flow_checks.result: returns false before New/Open state mutation; termination delegate returns terminateCancel.

control_flow_checks.path: Dirty -> Save -> write error or cancelled Save As
control_flow_checks.result: save method returns false without clearing isDirty; replacement/termination does not proceed; project and undo history remain in memory.
returns true; new scratch project is created; only then project/root, selections, waveform and undo/redo state are replaced and isDirty is cleared.
previous project and undo history remain; failed creation/read does not assign replacement state. New may already have stopped transport.

control_flow_checks.path: Dirty -> Save -> successful Open of current project
control_flow_checks.result: save completes before target manifest is read, avoiding the stale in-memory snapshot.
project/root/name are not committed; cleanup is attempted for the created destination and error is shown.

meter_and_undo_review: Meter callback reads sample buffers and computes peaks without reading actor state; delivery occurs on main queue with running/generation checks. Stop invalidates queued callbacks and resets engine and shell peak state.
Configure stops prior transport before replacing nodes and prepared buffers. Failed engine.start removes the meter tap. Hardware output quality/timing is not established by this inspection.
Undo/redo restore model snapshots, reconcile selection and rebuild waveforms. Named edits now remain in memory until explicit Save; scratch edits retain their recovery autosave.
related_test_note: The core worker retained 23 passing tests in five suites, including four interval-boundary tests. This reviewer verified referenced hashes and read the shared validator; these core tests do not automate modal shell decisions.
limitations: Native Save As modal success, failed-save prompts, permission variants, disk-full handling and application termination remain separate runtime checks; parent UI observations are not relabeled as this reviewer's observations.
Cleanup is best effort: permission or filesystem failures can prevent removing a partial destination.
Nested copied-file permissions, ACLs, internal absolute symlinks and concurrent external file changes are not exhaustively exercised.
The peak meter measures engine mixer buffers, not DAC/speaker output; timing, native mixer arithmetic order and dropout behavior remain unverified here.
Closing a window without terminating the process is not a tested lifecycle transition in this review.
No Cubase equivalence or target execution claim.
